content:
ana: Quick design pass on the dashboard toolbar. Noticed three small nits: compact gap between primary CTA + icon button on narrow view, toast appears under sticky header on scroll, and focus ring on icon-only buttons clips into adjacent cell. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/reviews/toolbar-compact.png
mike: thanks. which token is being used for the gap?
ana: it's using --space-xs (4px) inside .toolbar--compact. other toolbars use --space-2 (8px).
riley: for focus ring we could add `outline-offset: 3px` or switch to an inset focus ring for icon-only buttons. both keep contrast but avoid overlap on dense rows.
zoe: toast issue is caused by header creating a stacking context (transform). portal to body + a new token `--z-toast` should fix it without touching header.
dan: small accessibility ask: ensure icon-only buttons have aria-labels; saw a few relying on tooltip only.
ana: agreed. I'll update toolbar CSS to use --space-2 at breakpoint <= 600px, add outline-offset to icon buttons, and move toasts to a portal using --z-toast (value 1200). will also add aria-labels for kebab/run icons.
mike: can you include a visual regression for header+toast+modal stack? catches regressions early.
ana: will do. target patch for tomorrow if PRs are small.
design-bot: Reminder: tokens updated on main at 1785004200. Run `yarn tokens:build` after edits and include snapshots in PR.
